# vendor/scip

`scip.proto` is vendored verbatim from
<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sourcegraph/scip/main/scip.proto>.

- Fetched: 2026-09-24
- Upstream `main` at fetch time: `db62094c7f9d464d0a6d9fd7815fcf3c9214b4c2` (2026-09-20)
- Last commit touching `scip.proto`: `e01e97efac2f6b8c266b4d04825f1f1eab7b8f6c` (2026-07-06)
- sha256: `b38021b65ef90cbbf6af9c829ff75192859ad9b5da05439ef154bea4ceb2bf03`

TypeScript bindings live in `packages/core/src/scip/scip_pb.ts` (checked in),
generated by `npm run gen:scip` (`buf generate`, config in `/buf.gen.yaml`,
`protoc-gen-es` with `target=ts,import_extension=ts,erasable_syntax=true` so the
output runs under Node's built-in type stripping). Re-run only when this proto
changes, and review the diff of the generated file.
